result.instructions: Tools for Recharge, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Recharge data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run recharge_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run recharge_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run recharge_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. recharge_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: recharge_get_store
tools.title: Get store
tools.description: Get the Recharge store/shop info — name, domain, currency, timezone, and account settings. Recharge REST: GET /store.

tools.name: recharge_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions with optional filters (customer, address, status, ids, created/updated date ranges) and sorting. Returns { subscriptions }. Pagination is cursor-based: pass `limit` (default 50, max 250) and read `next_cursor` / `previous_cursor` from the response. IMPORTANT: when paging with `cursor`, Recharge accepts ONLY `limit` alongside it — omit every other filter on cursor requests. Recharge REST: GET /subscriptions.

status.description: Filter by subscription status, e.g. active | cancelled | expired.

ids.description: Comma-separated list of subscription ids to fetch.

created_at_min.description: Filter to subscriptions created on/after this date (ISO 8601).

created_at_max.description: Filter to subscriptions created on/before this date (ISO 8601).

updated_at_min.description: Filter to subscriptions updated on/after this date (ISO 8601).

updated_at_max.description: Filter to subscriptions updated on/before this date (ISO 8601).

sort_by.description: Sort order: id-asc | id-desc | created_at-asc | created_at-desc | updated_at-asc | updated_at-desc.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (next_cursor / previous_cursor from a prior response). Use it ALONE with `limit` — omit all other filters on cursor requests.

tools.name: recharge_skip_charge
tools.title: Skip charge
tools.description: SKIPS a scheduled charge — prevents it from processing on its scheduled date. This MODIFIES live billing data. Some stores require the specific line items to skip via `purchase_item_ids`. Recharge REST: POST /charges/{id}/skip with JSON body { purchase_item_ids? }. Returns { charge }.

purchase_item_ids.description: The subscription/onetime line item ids to skip (some stores require this).

tools.name: recharge_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel subscription
tools.description: CANCELS an active subscription — stops all future charges. This MODIFIES live data. A `cancellation_reason` is required. Recharge REST: POST /subscriptions/{id}/cancel with JSON body { cancellation_reason, cancellation_reason_comments? }. Returns { subscription }.

cancellation_reason_comments.description: Optional free-text detail about the cancellation.

tools.name: recharge_activate_subscription
tools.title: Activate subscription
tools.description: REACTIVATES a cancelled subscription — resumes future charges. This MODIFIES live data. Recharge REST: POST /subscriptions/{id}/activate (no body). Returns { subscription }.
